# Component tooltip setup outlives destroy and leaks ownInstance tooltips

## Context

Promoted from `defect-note` `MESSAGE:ab4c4e47-22fa-492e-a7ec-9f00b46dd9c6` (`fingerprint: 591044884db474a6`), observed in `test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/ViewportController.spec.mjs` when constructing and destroying `Portal.view.HeaderToolbar` before `Neo.tooltip.Base`'s dynamic `import()` settled:

```text
Neo.button.Base: 'cls' was set after destroy(). The write is ignored.
```

`#20080` (`PR #20141`, `08288e206b`) added the post-destroy setter refusal and development warning specifically so late writers like `Component#createTooltip → addCls` stay visible, explicitly leaving individual caller-side writers out of `#20080`'s scope.

- Live latest-open + closed sweep: checked latest 20 open (`61` open, red band; `#21606`..`#21411`) + open and closed search (`afterSetTooltip OR createTooltip OR ownInstance OR tooltip destroy`; read `Out of Scope` / `Avoided Traps` on `#20080`, `#21268`, `#21269`, `#5678`) at `2026-11-20T18:27:53Z`; no equivalent or prior exclusion found (standalone core bugfix — no open epic owns `Component#tooltip_` lifecycle).
- A2A in-flight claim sweep: checked latest 30 messages across all read states (`17:22Z`–`18:25Z`); `#21605` / `PR #21607` (`@neo-gemini-julia`) touches only `src/tooltip/Base.mjs` and `src/manager/DomEvent.mjs`, with zero overlap on `src/component/Base.mjs`.
- MC sweep: `'cls' was set after destroy afterSetTooltip tooltip ownInstance component destroy leak`, 5 results, no prior decision excluding caller cleanup (`#20080` explicitly deferred individual writers).
- Own-assignment sweep: 1 open (`#21598`, in review as `PR #21610`), none overlapping.

Ownership: self-assigned (`@neo-gemini-maryam`) — core `Neo.component.Base` destroy/async-import lifecycle bugfix (`good first issue` omitted for immediate maintainer delivery).

## The Problem

`src/component/Base.mjs` has three lifecycle gaps around `tooltip_`:

1. **Unchecked dynamic `import()` continuation (`afterSetTooltip`, lines `1021-1023`):** When `Neo.tooltip.Base` is not yet registered (`!Neo.ns('Neo.tooltip.Base')`), `import('../tooltip/Base.mjs').then(() => { me.createTooltip(value) })` runs unconditionally once the module resolves:
   - If the owner component was destroyed in flight, `createTooltip(value)` executes on the dead component — calling `Neo.tooltip.Base.delegateFromRootOf(me)` + `me.addCls('neo-uses-shared-tooltip')` + `me.update()` (emitting `'cls' was set after destroy()`) for shared tooltips, or constructing and leaking a live `Neo.tooltip.Base` instance in `InstanceManager` / `ComponentManager` for `ownInstance: true`.
   - If `component.tooltip` was cleared (`null`) or replaced while `import()` was in flight (including `A → null → A`), the stale `.then()` continuation still runs, resurrecting a cleared tooltip or leaking a superseded `ownInstance: true` `Neo.tooltip.Base`.
2. **Owned `ownInstance: true` tooltip leak on `Component#destroy()` (`lines 1437-1463`):** `destroy()` tears down `controller`, `plugins`, and `stateProvider`, but never destroys a dedicated `Neo.tooltip.Base` stored on `me._tooltip` (`ownInstance: true`), leaving the tooltip instance, its child `Label`, and any armed `show`/`hide`/`dismiss` timers alive after its owner component is destroyed.
3. **Shared-to-`ownInstance` class residue (`afterSetTooltip`, lines `1025-1029`):** `me.removeCls('neo-uses-shared-tooltip')` only runs in `else if (oldValue)` (when `!value`). Reconfiguring a component from a shared tooltip (`tooltip: 'Edit'`) to `tooltip: {ownInstance: true, text: 'Edit'}` leaves `'neo-uses-shared-tooltip'` on `me.cls`, so `Tooltip.delegateFilter` still matches the component and `Tooltip.applySingletonTargetConfig` spreads the `Neo.tooltip.Base` instance (`{...target._tooltip}`) onto the window's shared singleton.

## The Architectural Reality

- Design authority: `src/core/Base.mjs#destroy` JSDoc (*"Unregisters this instance from Neo.manager.Instance..."*) + `#20080` (`PR #20141`, post-destroy config-write refusal) + `#21268` (*"`ownInstance: true` should remain an explicit choice for components that need a dedicated instance"* while shared tooltips use `'neo-uses-shared-tooltip'` + `Tooltip.delegateFromRootOf`).
- `src/component/Base.mjs`:
  - `afterSetTooltip(value, oldValue)` (`lines 1012-1030`)
  - `createTooltip(value)` (`lines 1402-1429`)
  - `destroy(updateParentVdom=false, silent=false)` (`lines 1437-1463`)
- Pre-Flight (structural fast-path): authoring `test/playwright/unit/component/TooltipLifecycle.spec.mjs` matches sibling pattern of `test/playwright/unit/component/WrapperLifecycle.spec.mjs` and `test/playwright/unit/component/RevertFocusOnDeparture.spec.mjs` in `test/playwright/unit/component/`; sibling-file-lift applies; no novel directory choice.

## The Fix

1. Track a private `#tooltipSetupToken = null` on `Neo.component.Base`:
   - Reset `me.#tooltipSetupToken = null` at the top of `afterSetTooltip` and in `destroy()`.
   - Remove `'neo-uses-shared-tooltip'` whenever `oldValue` is truthy and `!value || value.ownInstance`.
   - Capture `const token = me.#tooltipSetupToken = {}` around `import('../tooltip/Base.mjs')` and invoke `me.createTooltip(value)` only when `!me.isDestroyed && me.#tooltipSetupToken === token && me._tooltip === value`.
2. In `Neo.component.Base#destroy()`, if `me._tooltip && !me._tooltip.isShared`, call `me._tooltip.destroy?.()` before `super.destroy(updateParentVdom, silent)` (leaving `me._tooltip` untouched if it is a plain config object, and never destroying a window's `isShared: true` singleton).
3. Add red-first unit coverage in `test/playwright/unit/component/TooltipLifecycle.spec.mjs` for all three lifecycle paths.

## Decision Record impact

`none` — localized `Neo.component.Base` lifecycle cleanup aligned with `#20080` and `#21268`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: Destroying a component (or clearing/replacing `component.tooltip`, including `A → null → A`) before `afterSetTooltip`'s dynamic `import('../tooltip/Base.mjs')` resolves emits zero post-destroy config-write warnings, adds no `'neo-uses-shared-tooltip'` class, and leaks no `Neo.tooltip.Base` instance.
- [ ] AC-2: Destroying a component configured with `tooltip: {ownInstance: true, ...}` destroys its owned `Neo.tooltip.Base` instance while leaving any window `isShared: true` singleton intact.
- [ ] AC-3: Switching `component.tooltip` from a shared tooltip to `{ownInstance: true, ...}` removes `'neo-uses-shared-tooltip'` from `component.cls`.
- [ ] AC-4: Unit tests in `test/playwright/unit/component/TooltipLifecycle.spec.mjs` fail on `dev` and pass with the fix, and `ViewportController.spec.mjs` runs with zero `'cls' was set after destroy()` warnings.

## Out of Scope

- Shared-tooltip pointer departure / `[data-neo-tooltip]` delegation (`#21605` / `PR #21607`).
- Clearing `#configs` on destroyed instances (`#20080` Out of Scope).

## Avoided Traps

- **Guarding `.then()` only on `me._tooltip === value` without a setup token:** `c.tooltip = 'A'; c.tooltip = null; c.tooltip = 'A'` while `import()` is in flight leaves both `.then()` callbacks seeing `me._tooltip === 'A'` and running `createTooltip('A')` twice.
- **Setting `me.tooltip = null` inside `Component#destroy()`:** triggers `afterSetTooltip(null, old)` → `removeCls` VDOM mutation during teardown; destroying `!me._tooltip?.isShared && me._tooltip?.destroy?.()` directly avoids teardown `cls` churn.
